description: Curated prerequisite DAG over the study corpus.  Nodes are concepts, not files: each names the docs/lesson-plan/lab/project files that teach it and the app categories that drill it, so tools/concept_map.py can compute per-concept mastery from the shared study history.  Edges are "needs": A needs B means B should be solid before A makes sense.  Hand-curated -- run `tools/concept_map.py --check` after every edit.

mastery._comment: threshold: decayed accuracy (0-1) a concept must reach to count as mastered.  min_evidence: decayed graded-item count required alongside it (dashboard's 14-day half-life supplies the decay).  seen_evidence: below this a concept counts as untouched rather than weak.
